## Atelier Saigal: The Timepiece Archive & Horological Vault
- **Vault URL:** https://rishavsaigal.web.app/watches
- **Curator:** Rishav Saigal
- **Curatorial Scope:** 7 independently owned and physically maintained mechanical, solar, and high-frequency timepieces.
- **Curatorial Methodology (E-E-A-T):** Every timepiece is physically owned, inspected under 10× optical loupe magnification, and evaluated for mechanical timing tolerances under active wrist rotation. Zero affiliate links or retail aggregations.

### The 7 Curated Timepieces

#### 1. Kenneth Cole New York Automatic Skeleton (Ref: KCWGL2104102MN)
- **URL:** https://rishavsaigal.web.app/watches/kenneth-cole-kcwgl2104102mn
- **Category:** Haute Skeleton / Open-Heart Mechanical
- **Acquired:** 2025 (In Active Rotation)
- **Caliber Engine:** 21-Jewel Mechanical Automatic (Self-Winding) with auxiliary crown manual winding
- **Frequency:** 21,600 vibrations per hour (vph) / 3.0 Hz (6 beats/second)
- **Power Autonomy:** ~36 to 40 Hours
- **Synthetic Jewels:** 21 Synthetic Corundum Rubies
- **Dimensions:** 44.0 mm diameter × 12.0 mm thickness (Lug width: 22.0 mm)
- **Metallurgy:** 316L Stainless Steel in Matte Mocha IP (Ion-Plated) Finish
- **Crystal:** Beveled Mineral Glass (Front) & Exhibition Glass (Caseback)
- **Water Resistance:** 30 Meters (3 ATM / 3 Bar)
- **Signature Architecture:** Multi-layer skeleton cutaway exposing brass gear train, mainspring barrel, and oscillating balance wheel beneath suspended cream chapter ring.

#### 2. Fastrack Opulence Chronograph (Ref: NT3315KM01)

- **Caliber Engine:** Analog Multi-Function Quartz Chronograph (32,768 Hz)
- **Complications:** Split-Second Chronograph Stopwatch, Diurnal 24-Hour Sun & Moon Indicator, Date Display
- **Power Autonomy:** ~2 to 3 Years (SR920SW Silver Oxide Cell)
- **Dimensions:** 45.0 mm diameter × 12.5 mm thickness (Lug width: 22.0 mm)
- **Metallurgy:** Stainless Steel in Anthracite PVD Gunmetal Finish
- **Crystal:** Scratch-Resistant Hardened Mineral Crystal
- **Water Resistance:** 50 Meters (5 ATM / 5 Bar)
- **Signature Architecture:** 24-hour aperture disc rotating synchronously to display golden solar zenith at noon and nocturnal lunar constellations at midnight, paired with crimson pushers.
